title: Validation of Systems
section_text: Validation of systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records.

title: Protection and Accurate Retrieval of Records
section_text: The ability to generate accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency.

title: Time-Stamped Audit Trails
section_text: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.

title: Signature Manifestations
section_text: Signed electronic records shall contain information associated with the signing that clearly indicates the printed name of the signer, the date and time when the signature was executed, and the meaning associated with the signature.

title: Audit Trails
section_text: Consideration should be given, based on a risk assessment, to building into the system the creation of a record of all GMP-relevant changes and deletions (a system generated 'audit trail'). For change or deletion of GMP-relevant data the reason should be documented.

title: Data Storage and Backup
section_text: Regular back-ups of all relevant data should be taken. Integrity and accuracy of backup data and the ability to restore the data should be checked during validation and monitored periodically.
